visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a retail display shelf in a brightly lit store. The shelves are packed with various pink, white, and red packaged health and beauty products. A large yellow mesh grid serves as the background. Centered on the screen is a large text overlay in white with a red outline. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a plush, gray cat-shaped object resting on a shelf. A hand enters the frame and gently strokes the soft, faux-fur texture of the cat's 'belly'. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the fabric. (3) The scene shifts to a display of 'tutuanna' brand thermal clothing. The camera pans across posters showing different styles of black thermal tops, including off-the-shoulder and lace-trimmed versions. A hand holds a retail-packaged black garment and then touches the fabric of a sample top to demonstrate its soft, fleece-like interior. (4) The shot transitions to a close-up of a yellow and white box labeled '温女子' (Onjoshi). It appears to be a belly warmer product. The packaging is held briefly before the camera. (5) The final visual phase shows an outdoor street scene in Japan during the day. A large white building with 'OIOI' branding is visible in the background under a clear blue sky. A few pedestrians and a car are seen at a distance. The video ends with a pink circular logo containing Japanese text and social media icons.
